SELECT NULL AS binding_id, sh.id AS shop_id, sh.poi_id, sh.epoi_id, COALESCE(sh.poi_name, sh.name) AS shop_name, sh.address, COALESCE(sh.contact_phone, sh.phone) AS contact_phone, COALESCE(ob.user_id, sb.user_id) AS bound_user_id, COALESCE(ou.nickname, ou.username, ob.user_id, su.nickname, su.username, sb.user_id) AS bound_user_name, AS binding_domain, AS binding_domain_name, AS binding_status, AS binding_status_name, ob.id AS ordinary_binding_id, ob.user_id AS ordinary_bound_user_id, COALESCE(ou.nickname, ou.username, ob.user_id) AS ordinary_bound_user_name, ob.create_time AS ordinary_bind_time, sb.id AS sales_binding_id, sb.user_id AS sales_bound_user_id, COALESCE(su.nickname, su.username, sb.user_id) AS sales_bound_user_name, su.phone AS sales_bound_user_phone, sb.create_time AS sales_bind_time, COALESCE(pa.balance, 0) AS power_balance, COALESCE(pa.total_recharge, 0) AS total_recharge, COALESCE(pa.total_grant, 0) AS total_grant, COALESCE(pa.total_consume, 0) AS total_consume, sr.right_expire_at, AS bind_time, COALESCE(obc.binding_count, 0) AS ordinary_binding_count, COALESCE(sbc.binding_count, 0) AS sales_binding_count FROM mt_shop sh
LEFT JOIN mt_power_account pa ON pa.shop_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shop_id, MAX(expire_at) AS right_expire_at FROM mt_shop_right WHERE expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at > NOW() GROUP BY shop_id ) sr ON sr.shop_id = sh.id

SELECT NULL AS binding_id, sh.id AS shop_id, sh.poi_id, sh.epoi_id, COALESCE(sh.poi_name, sh.name) AS shop_name, sh.address, COALESCE(sh.contact_phone, sh.phone) AS contact_phone, COALESCE(ob.user_id, sb.user_id) AS bound_user_id, COALESCE(ou.nickname, ou.username, ob.user_id, su.nickname, su.username, sb.user_id) AS bound_user_name, AS binding_domain, AS binding_domain_name, AS binding_status, AS binding_status_name, ob.id AS ordinary_binding_id, ob.user_id AS ordinary_bound_user_id, COALESCE(ou.nickname, ou.username, ob.user_id) AS ordinary_bound_user_name, sb.id AS sales_binding_id, sb.user_id AS sales_bound_user_id, COALESCE(su.nickname, su.username, sb.user_id) AS sales_bound_user_name, su.phone AS sales_bound_user_phone, COALESCE(pa.balance, 0) AS balance, COALESCE(pa.recharge_balance, 0) AS recharge_balance, COALESCE(pa.grant_balance, 0) AS grant_balance, COALESCE(pa.total_recharge, 0) AS total_recharge, COALESCE(pa.total_grant, 0) AS total_grant, COALESCE(pa.total_consume, 0) AS total_consume, AS bind_time, COALESCE(obc.binding_count, 0) AS ordinary_binding_count, COALESCE(sbc.binding_count, 0) AS sales_binding_count FROM mt_shop sh
LEFT JOIN mt_power_account pa ON pa.shop_id = sh.id

LEFT JOIN ai_user_shop_binding ob ON ob.shop_id = sh.id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_user_shop_binding newer_ob WHERE newer_ob.shop_id = ob.shop_id AND ( newer_ob.create_time > ob.create_time OR (newer_ob.create_time = ob.create_time AND newer_ob.id > ob.id) ) ) LEFT JOIN ai_sales_user_shop_binding sb ON sb.shop_id = sh.id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_sales_user_shop_binding newer_sb WHERE newer_sb.shop_id = sb.shop_id AND ( newer_sb.create_time > sb.create_time OR (newer_sb.create_time = sb.create_time AND newer_sb.id > sb.id) ) ) LEFT JOIN ai_user ou ON ou.user_id = ob.user_id LEFT JOIN ai_user su ON su.user_id = sb.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shop_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ai_user_shop_binding GROUP BY shop_id ) obc ON obc.shop_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shop_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ai_sales_user_shop_binding GROUP BY shop_id ) sbc ON sbc.shop_id = sh.id
CASE WHEN ob.id IS NOT NULL AND sb.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALL' WHEN ob.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ORDINARY' WHEN sb.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SALES' ELSE 'ALL' END
CASE WHEN ob.id IS NOT NULL AND sb.id IS NOT NULL THEN '普通商户 / 网销用户' WHEN ob.id IS NOT NULL THEN '普通商户' WHEN sb.id IS NOT NULL THEN '网销用户' ELSE '未绑定' END
CASE WHEN ob.id IS NOT NULL AND sb.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'BOTH' WHEN ob.id IS NOT NULL OR sb.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'BOUND' ELSE 'UNBOUND' END
CASE WHEN ob.id IS NOT NULL AND sb.id IS NOT NULL THEN '双绑定' WHEN ob.id IS NOT NULL OR sb.id IS NOT NULL THEN '已绑定' ELSE '未绑定' END
CASE WHEN ob.create_time IS NULL THEN sb.create_time WHEN sb.create_time IS NULL THEN ob.create_time WHEN ob.create_time >= sb.create_time THEN ob.create_time ELSE sb.create_time END

sql.if: AND ob.id IS NULL AND sb.id IS NULL
AND (ob.id IS NOT NULL OR sb.id IS NOT NULL)
AND ob.id IS NOT NULL AND sb.id IS NOT NULL
